items.title: China’s CXMT Says It Has Reached Advanced DRAM Mass Production, Challenging Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron in Memory Chips
items.summary: On Sunday, China’s ChangXin Memory Technologies (CXMT) said it has begun mass production using a fifth-generation DRAM technology platform. This marks a potential step forward in Beijing’s effort to build a stronger domestic rival to Samsung Electronics Co. (OTC:SSNLF), SK Hynix (NASDAQ:SKHY) and Micron Technology (NASDAQ:MU).
